_about: Curated figures for /landmark-numbers/uk-and-nations/. Each measure gives a value for the UK and each nation, with its period and source. Formats: int, km2, years1, pct1, money, money2. The quarterly Claude scheduled task checks these and opens a pull request when newer figures are published.
